templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum: terms supplementing an existing agreement for a provider's AI services, covering use of inputs and outputs.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) governing the use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) for selling and buying SaaS / cloud software subscriptions.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement (DPA) setting out how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer (GDPR and similar privacy laws).

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement giving an early partner access to a product in exchange for feedback.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page of the Common Paper Mutual NDA, where the parties fill in the business terms (purpose, dates, governing law) and sign.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA (MNDA) for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships where each party performs agreed obligations, including joint marketing.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for letting a customer evaluate a product for a limited pilot period.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for services delivered under statements of work (SOWs).

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining target uptime, support response times and service credits for a cloud service.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing software that the customer installs and runs itself.
